name: Gutterlight
author: kolache
description: A rain-soaked gothic city drawn as a crime comic: every message, widget and dialog is an inked panel with a slanted edge, titles are yellow caption boxes and your lines are speech balloons. Grim overcast newsprint by day, ink and sodium light by night.

credits.what: City backdrops, roofline, gargoyle, card art, newsprint scraps, avatar silhouette
